recent.text: Additional #SFGiants roster moves: - Non-tendered RHP Rowan Wick and OF Victor Bericoto. - Arbitration eligible players LHP Sam Hentges, RHP Randy Rodriguez and IF Casey Schmitt have all been tendered contracts. - Additionally, the Giants and RHP Camilo Doval have agreed to terms

recent.text: The #SFGiants and the Rays completed a trade today with RHP Cole Stokes joining the Giants organization in exchange for IF Christian Koss.
